assumptions: E has the same finite real Hilbert/Borel/full-space structure including dimension zero. Source V is C2 with all-point/all-direction alpha I<=Hess V<=beta I, alpha,beta NNReal, 0<alpha<=beta, eta>0 and beta eta<=1.

Actual common Gibbs/Gaussian augmentation J and Markov disintegrating R/S are constructed. S_y=(2x-y)#R_y is precisely volume.tilted(-W_y), W_y(z)=V((y+z)/2)+norm(z-y)^2/(8eta), with true C2 regularity and positive integrable partition.

For every y one original dense closable compact-smooth gradient D_y with closed closure is fixed before epsilon/input. For each epsilon>0 and true f in L2(S_y), one u/G/r serves all compact sets, ordinary tests and all C2 compact cutoffs. Existence is fiberwise; no jointly measurable solution selector, RGO operator identity or localized weighted-domain membership is concluded.

Retain the actual all-domain variational equation, ordinary locally integrable u/G, all C1 compact directional weak-gradient tests, squared local integrability of r=epsilon*u+inner(grad W_y,G)-f, compact-volume L2 of u/G/r and every C2 original distribution test. For every C2 compact chi define v=chi*u, Gchi=chi*G+u*grad chi, Fchi=chi*r+2 inner(grad chi,G)+u Delta chi. Prove genuine global-volume L2 of v/Gchi/Fchi and each topological support contained in tsupport chi. For every C2 compact phi both PDE products are L1 with integral v Delta phi=integral Fchi phi. The same u is chosen before all cutoffs; only smooth test/cutoff functions have classical derivatives. steps.title: Construct the genuine common augmentation and reflection
steps.text: Apply the actual conditional gradient producer to source V/alpha/beta/eta. Retain common Markov R/S, disintegration of the actual Gaussian/Gibbs joint law, and selected reflected S_y for every y.

steps.title: Keep the exact reflected density and operator scale
steps.text: Retain true W_y(z)=V((y+z)/2)+norm(z-y)^2/(8eta), C2 regularity and the positive integrable partition. Reflected Hessian is quarter-scaled; the unreflected RGO law, Dirichlet form and epsilon parameter are not identified without an actual adapter.

steps.title: Fix D_y and then one u before all cutoffs
steps.text: For each fiber retain original dense closable exact compact-smooth D_y with closed closure before epsilon/forcing. The shared producer constructs u after those inputs, then all cutoffs use that u/G/r. No cutoff-specific operator or jointly measurable fiberwise solution is inserted.

steps.title: Derive every localized property from this actual fiber
steps.text: Rewrite only the actual S_y=volume.tilted(-W_y) equality and apply the shared same-D producer. Global volume L2/support and both tested weak equations are conclusions, not new paper assumptions; keep every parent variational/ordinary/local-L2 property.

steps.title: Exercise an actual nonquadratic law and unnormalized cutoff
steps.text: The focused Test uses V(x)=3x^2/8+sin(x)/8, genuine curvature in [1/2,1], eta in (0,1], an ordinary smooth bump chi with rIn1/rOut2 and the actual C2 test phi(x)=rho(x)(x^2)^(5/2), rho the normalized bump. For every source fiber/epsilon/forcing it extracts actual global L2/support, the particular directional weak-gradient equation at a=1, both PDE integrabilities and the localized PDE for the same u.

steps.title: Preserve the remaining full-paper and analytic obligations
steps.text: This proves fiberwise compact localization. It supplies no localized weighted-domain membership, joint measurable selector, H2/core/Bochner, Poincare/BL, noncompact domains, epsilon0, invariance/hypocoercivity/cost or either complete sampling/composition result. The original reflected/RGO contracts remain separate.
